name: mumbrass-dev
description: Mumbrass template - build moderno (sass + pug + browser-sync)

scripts.css: sass --load-path=sass --silence-deprecation=import,color-functions,global-builtin,if-function,slash-div sass/main.sass app/css/main.css --no-source-map && postcss app/css/main.css --use autoprefixer -o app/css/main.min.css --no-map && cleancss app/css/main.min.css -o app/css/main.min.css
scripts.html: npm run html:pt && npm run html:en
scripts.build: npm run css && npm run html
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n css,html,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm:watch:css" "npm:watch:html" "npm:serve"
